description: This file defines the MilestonesSubController class within the Goteo project's admin namespace. It manages CRUD operations and permissions related to project milestones, including editing, adding, listing, and removing milestones, as well as predefined milestone types and link types.

classes.name: MilestonesSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing project milestones in the admin panel, with static properties for labels and types, and methods for CRUD operations and permission checks.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a user has permission to access milestone management, limited to master node and superadmin or root roles.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing milestone, including updating type, link, description, and images.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding a new milestone, setting type, description, and images.
